boracay.name: Boracay
boracay.short_description: Maputi a dalampasigan a pasig at masigla a bengi king metung king pinakamalagu a pulu keng yatu.
boracay.content: Ing Boracay metung ya keng pinakamabiyayag a destinasyun da reng turista keng Filipinas, at lawan ya ming kasapi keng pinakamalagu a pulu keng yatu. Ing pinakamahalaga yang bahagi ya ing White Beach, metung a 4-kilometrung dalampasigan a maputi at malambut a pasig at malinaw a danum. Pelimbasan ning pamagpapayapa king pangpang, atin yang parasailing, kiteboarding, scuba diving, at paglayag king paraw keng lulubugan ning aldo ing Boracay.
highlights: Paglayag king paraw keng lulubugan ning aldo
travel_tips: Mag-reserba nung maaga ning panuluyan kapanaun ning dakal a turista
Sundan ding lokal a patakaran para king kapaligiran keng pamasok king dalampasigan
Subukan ing island-hopping keng malapit a maliit a luklukan ning dagat
Gamitan ding traysikel para king malapit a bayahe king pulu

el-nido.name: Palawan (El Nido)
el-nido.short_description: Matayutang bunduk a batung-apug, makalingid a lagoon, at pandaigdigang island hopping.
el-nido.content: Ing El Nido mayayaman ya king matas a bunduk a batung-apug at makalingid a lagoon nung nu ika makapag-kayak o makapaligo king luntiang danum. Bahagi ning Palawan, a tinatawag a Huling Hangganan, ing El Nido metung ya a mahalagang hiyas ning bayahe keng Timog-Silangang Asya a atin yang makamamanghang karst a tanawan at malinaw a lagoon.
travel_tips: Sumali king organisadung Tour A/B/C/D a pakete para keng pamasok king lagoon
Magdala ng sunscreen a ligtas para king reef
Makabuklod ya ing pera kareng maliit a negosyu
Maglaan ng 3–4 a aldo para mapasyalan ya nung tutu

coron.name: Palawan (Coron)
coron.short_description: Malinis a lawa, lagoon, at bantug a wreck diving.
coron.content: Ing Coron bantug ya king buong yatu bilang kareng makamamanghang lawa, lagoon, at lugar ning diving. Ing Kayangan Lake tinatawag yang pinakamalinis a lawa keng Asya, a palibutan da reng matas a bunduk a batung-apug. Para kareng divers, reng lunud a barku ning WWII atin la king lalam ning dagat, a mibalu lang lugar ning diving a mapuno ning korales.
highlights: Diving kareng lunud a barku ning WWII
travel_tips: Bayaran ing bayad para king kapaligiran king opisina ning turismo
Mag-reserba nung maaga king dive shop kapanaun ning dakal a turista
Mamuntuk nung maaga king island tour para maiwasan ing dakal a tau
Lumipad pasaup king Busuanga Airport at mag-van pasaup king bayan ning Coron

cebu.name: Cebu
cebu.short_description: Kasaysayan, canyoneering, at ing Queen City ning Timog.
cebu.content: Ing Cebu pamagsasamasamang kasaysayan, buhay king lakanbalen, at pakikipagsapalaran king labas. Keng Lakanbalen ning Cebu, reng bantug a lugar a singsing ning Magellan's Cross at Basilica Minore del Santo Niño ding mamitnang kayamanan ning Kastila ning pulu. Para kareng mangibig king kalikasan, ing Kawasan Falls king Badian bantug ya king canyoneering king asul-luntiang danum.
travel_tips: Lumipad pasaup king Mactan–Cebu International Airport
Mag-reserba ning canyoneering tour kareng gabay a atin lisensya
Pagsamasamang ing paglakad king kasaysayan ning lakanbalen at maiksing bayahe king timog ning Cebu
Subukan ing lechon at uga a mangga

bohol.name: Bohol
bohol.short_description: Chocolate Hills, tarsier, at maputing dalampasigan ning Panglao.
bohol.content: Ing Bohol bantug ya king bukud-tanging kayamanan ning kalikasan at kultura. Ing Chocolate Hills metung yang makamamanghang tanawan a mayayari king lalu pang 1,200 a bunduk-bunduk a natatakpan ning dikut. Reng Philippine tarsier, maliit a primate a atin lang malaking mata, ipagmalasakit la kareng lokal a santuaryu. Ing Pulung Panglao atin yang resort at pamasok king coral reef para king diving.
travel_tips: Umarkila ning motorsiklu o sumali kareng countryside tour para kareng bunduk at simbahan
Dalawan mu lang ding tarsier kareng aprubadung santuaryu
Ding fast ferry mamagkonekta la king Cebu at Bohol king mga 2 oras
Pagsamasamang ing tour king bunduk at ing river cruise a atin yang pamanyaman

siargao.name: Siargao
siargao.short_description: Kabisera ning surfing a atin lagoon, pulu, at mapayapang buhay king pulu.
siargao.content: Bantug bilang Surfing Capital ning Filipinas, ing Siargao mamanyaki da reng surfer manibala king Cloud 9. Pelimbasan ning alon, ing Magpupungko Rock Pools at Sugba Lagoon atin lang paglangui at paddleboarding a palibutan ning bakawan.
travel_tips: Umarkila ning scooter para mapasyalan ing pulu
Mag-reserba nung maaga ning boat tour para king Sohoton
Igalang ing lokal a kaugalian da reng surfer king lineup
Malawak a gagamitan ing pera at e-wallet
siargao.best_time_to_visit: Agostu–Nobiembre para king surf; Marso–Mayu para king kalmadung danum

baguio.name: Baguio
baguio.short_description: Malamig a pamagpapayapaan king bunduk at Summer Capital ning Filipinas.
baguio.content: Tinatawag a Summer Capital ning Filipinas, ing Baguio metung yang makapagpapasigla a pamagpapayapaan king bunduk a atin yang malamig a klima, bunduk a natatakpan ning pino, at masiglang kultura. Ing Burnham Park, Strawberry Farm king La Trinidad, at Session Road ing mamipakilala king karanasan king lakanbalen.
travel_tips: Magdala ning magaan a jacket pati king tag-araw
Subukan ing ube jam at lokal a kape
Mabagat ing trapiku king katapusan ning sanga-linggu manibala king Manila
Dalawan ing Tam-awan Village para king sining ning Cordillera
baguio.best_time_to_visit: Febrero para king Panagbenga o Marso–Mayu para king pinakamalamig a panaun

vigan.name: Vigan
vigan.short_description: Lakanbalen a kayamanan ning UNESCO a atin batung kalsada at gandang kolonyal a Kastila.
vigan.content: Metung a UNESCO World Heritage Site, ing Vigan dinan yang ding bisita keng panaun ning kolonyal a Kastila. Ing Calle Crisologo palibutan ya ning mapag-ibat a bale a daan-daan ya tauan, batung kalsada, at karwahe a hila ning kabayu a mamilatik king maginit a ilaw ning parol king bengi.
travel_tips: Matuknang ning metung a bengi para mamasdan ing Calle Crisologo a maylaw king bengi
Subukan ing empanada at longganisa king Plaza Burgos
Pagsamasamang king Pagudpud o Banaue king metung a bayahe king palibot ning hilaga ning Luzon
Magsuot ning kumportableng sapatus para kareng batung kalsada

banaue-rice-terraces.name: Banaue Rice Terraces
banaue-rice-terraces.short_description: Mapaglumang hagdan-hagdang bukid a inukit king bunduk — metung a kamanghaan ning UNESCO.
banaue-rice-terraces.content: Ing Banaue Rice Terraces, a tinatawag a Maykawalung Kamanghaan ning Yatu, inukit ya king bunduk lalu pang 2,000 ya taun a milabas. Ing mas malayung terraces ning Batad, a anyung amphitheater, gagamitan pa mu naman da reng komunidad ning Ifugao king pagtanam.
highlights: Reng baryu ning kayamanan ning Ifugao
travel_tips: Umarkila ning lokal a gabay para kareng trek king Batad
Atin lang bus king bengi manibala king Manila (9–10 oras)
Magsuot ning matibay a sapatus — ding dalan maki-tarik at maputik
Igalang ding komunidad ning magsasaka at ding hangganan ning terraces
banaue-rice-terraces.best_time_to_visit: Disiembre angga Mayu para king trekking; panaun ning anihan para king ginintuang tanawan

chocolate-hills.name: Chocolate Hills
chocolate-hills.short_description: Lalu pang 1,000 a bukud-tanging bunduk a anyung simboryo a mibalung brown king panaun a tuyu.
chocolate-hills.content: Ing Chocolate Hills metung yang pormasyun ning lupa a atin lalu pang 1,000 a bunduk-bunduk a natatakpan ning dikut a mibalung chocolate-brown king panaun a tuyu, a gumawa king metung kareng pinakakilalang tanawan ning Filipinas.
travel_tips: Dalawan nung maaga king umaga para king mas malinaw a tanawan
Pagsamasamang king buong countryside tour ning Bohol
Magdala ning panglaban king aldo — bukas ya ing tanawan
Pagsamasamang king Panglao para king dagdag a pamagpapayapa king dalampasigan

camiguin.name: Camiguin
camiguin.short_description: Pulung bulkan a atin maginit a bukal, talon, at ing Sunken Cemetery.
camiguin.content: Tinatawag a Pulung Mibayag king Apuy, ing Camiguin atin yang bulkan, maginit a bukal, at ing makatatakut a Sunken Cemetery a atin yang malaking krus a tatindeg king dagat. Ing sandbar ning White Island atin yang malawak a tanawan king Bulkan Hibok-Hibok.
travel_tips: Umarkila ning multicab o motorsiklu para mailibut ing pulu
Tingnan ing panaun bago ing bayahe king bangka pasaup king White Island
Subukan ing lanzones nung panaun
Mayap ya ing lipad o ferry manibala king Cagayan de Oro
camiguin.best_time_to_visit: Marso–Mayu o Oktubre para king Lanzones Festival

davao.name: Davao
davao.short_description: Pintu pasaup king Mt. Apo, agila ning Filipinas, at pusu ning kultura ning Mindanao.
davao.content: Ing Lakanbalen ning Davao ya ing pinakamalaking lakanbalen king Mindanao, a mamalansa king pamagsulong ning lakanbalen at kamanghaan ning kalikasan. Pintu ya pasaup king Bunduk Apo, ing pinakamatas a tuktok ning bansa, at ing Philippine Eagle Center ing mamitagun king nanganganib a pambansang ibon.
highlights: Pamilihan ning durian at lutung dagat
travel_tips: Lumipad pasaup king Davao International Airport
Tingnan ding travel advisory para kareng trek king bunduk
Subukan ing durian, pomelo, at inihaw a tuna
Ing Pulung Samal malapit la, maiksing bayahe king ferry
davao.best_time_to_visit: Marso para king Araw ng Dabaw o Agostu para king Kadayawan Festival

sagada.name: Sagada
sagada.short_description: Malamig a bayan king kabunduk a atin yungib, talon, at nakasabit a kabaong.
sagada.content: Ing Sagada bantug ya king malamig a klima, mayamang tradisyun da reng Igorot, at makamamanghang tanawan. Reng Nakasabit a Kabaong ning Echo Valley mamipakit la ning mapaglumang paraan ning paglibing. Ing Sumaguing Cave at Bomod-ok Falls babayaran da reng bisitang mahilig king pakikipagsapalaran.
travel_tips: Umarkila ning gabay king yungib — kailangan ya ini para king Sumaguing
Asahan ing malamig a bengi; magdala ning dakal a damit
Ing bus manibala king Baguio mga 5 oras
Igalang ding sagradung lugar ning paglibing at lokal a kaugalian

mayon-volcano.name: Mayon Volcano
mayon-volcano.short_description: Bulkan a halus sakdal a kono ing anyu a atin yang ATV, guba, at makamamanghang tanawan.
mayon-volcano.content: Ing Bulkan Mayon bantug ya king halus sakdal a anyung kono. Pamamangaan da reng bisita ing gandang yang keng Cagsawa Ruins, nung nu reng labi ning simbahan tatindeg la bilang alaala ning pamagbuga ning 1814. Ding ATV king paldan ning bunduk dinagdag da ing pakikipagsapalaran king karanasan.
travel_tips: Lumipad pasaup king Legazpi para king pinakamayap a pamasok
Ing tanawan nanayun ya king panaun — maglaan ning dagdag a aldo
Subukan ing Bicol Express at laing
Pagsamasamang king Donsol kapanaun ning whale shark
mayon-volcano.best_time_to_visit: Disiembre–Abril para king malinaw a tanawan

kawasan-falls.name: Cebu (Kawasan Falls)
kawasan-falls.short_description: Asul-luntiang talon at bantug a canyoneering a pakikipagsapalaran.
kawasan-falls.content: Ing Kawasan Falls bantug ya king canyoneering king asul-luntiang danum at talon. Ing talon a atin yang dakal a antas metung ya kareng pinakamaragul pakuan ning larawan a natural a atraksyun ning Cebu at mayap yang isama kareng bayahe king pangpang ning timog ning Cebu.
highlights: Kawasan Falls a atin yang atlung antas
travel_tips: Mag-reserba ning canyoneering kareng aprubadung operator
Magsuot ning matibay a sapatus king danum
Mamuntuk nung maaga para maiwasan ing dakal a tau
Ilagay ding elektroniku king dry bag

intramuros.name: Intramuros (Manila)
intramuros.short_description: Makasaysayan a lakanbalen a atin yang pader king kalagitnaan ning kabisera ning Filipinas.
intramuros.content: Ing lakanbalen a atin yang pader ning Intramuros ing sentro ning kayamanan ning Maynila, nung nu reng batung kalsada ding mamitudtud king Fort Santiago at San Agustin Church, metung a UNESCO World Heritage site.
travel_tips: Maglakad o magbisikleta king pader nung maaga king umaga
Pagsamasamang king pamasyal king National Museum
Abangan ding pagtatanghal ning kultura king katapusan ning sanga-linggu
Gamitan ding ride-hailing app para king trapiku ning Maynila

panglao.name: Panglao Island
panglao.short_description: Maputing dalampasigan a pasig at pintu ning diving malapit king Bohol.
panglao.content: Ing Panglao atin yang resort, dalampasigan, at pamasok king coral reef para king diving, at ing Alona Beach ya ing pangunahing sentro ning island-hopping at pamangan keng lulubugan ning aldo.
travel_tips: Lumipad pasaup king Bohol–Panglao International Airport
Mag-reserba nung maaga ning diving kapanaun ning bakasyun
Pagsamasamang king metung-aldung tour king Chocolate Hills
Igalang ding marine protected area

apo-island.name: Apo Island
apo-island.short_description: Santuaryu king dagat a bantug king pawikan at snorkeling.
apo-island.content: Ing Apo Island metung yang pinagmalasakitan a santuaryu king dagat nung nu reng pawikan mamilanguy la keng kalibutan ning makulay a coral reef, a mapupuntan king bangka manibala king Dumaguete o Dauin.
highlights: Snorkeling a kaibat da reng pawikan
travel_tips: Bayaran ing bayad ning santuaryu king dagat
Ali kayu tutukun ding pawikan at korales
Magdala ning snorkel gear o umarkila king lugar
Mamuntuk nung maaga king bayahe king bangka para king mas kalmadung dagat
